title: 第十章 版本还能更新？
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
成功回到领地，简单清点了一下今日的收获。

    除了秦天自己用强化过后的石镐，进行了一定的资源的开采以外，这些领民也给他带来了相应的收获。

    虽然比起他的开采速度来讲，要慢上不少，但是总的说来，这些领民们进行开采，也能在一定程度上收集到足够的资源。

    前期建筑和设施不多，这时候自己还能分得出一些闲心，亲自加入到采集资源的队伍当中。

    但是随着领地继续发展发育下去，这样的时间，注定会变得越来越少。

    到时候这些工具总要交给领民来使用，与其如此，不如让他们现在就尝试着上手。

    更何况现在前期需要发展，需要发育，对于这些资源，都会有一定的需求量。

    简单清点完毕，秦天还没来得及有动作，眼前就出现了提示。

    【击杀凶兽的领主已达10人，将陆续增加凶兽投放量，促进领主升级！】

    【凶兽刷新概率增加10%】

    这条提示出现，世界频道刷屏的速度又再次变得无比快。

    【？？？？？？】

    【咋回事啊？！这么快就有这么多领主，成功击杀凶兽了吗？刚才我们在野外遭遇了，战斗力很强，组队才能成功将其打跑，要击杀都很困难！】

    【我请问呢？这合理吗？！我这发育半天，连温饱都是个问题，咋还一会儿没看就有这么多人击杀凶兽了？】

    【你们懂什么？真正的大佬哪有时间水世界频道？】

    【哈哈哈！是这个道理，感觉哭惨的人那么多，还是有大佬能击杀凶兽！】

    【之前我加了一个大佬好友，他跟我说他就击杀了凶兽，那兽核还可以卖钱，还可以升级呢！】

    【这是要我的命吗？凶兽的刷新数量增多，我还怎么发育？！】

    ……

    因为这个提示，世界频道里就有不少人开始疯狂吐槽起来。

    但大多数人吐槽的方向还是一致的，都在表达对凶兽会增加刷新量这件事情的震惊，与此同时就是不少玩家的痛哭哀嚎。

    对于绝大部分玩家而言，他们现在能做的事情就是组队，跟别的领主打好关系，一起共同发展。
content_en:
I successfully returned to the territory and took a brief inventory of today’s harvest.

    In addition to Qin Tian himself using the enhanced stone pickaxe to mine a certain amount of resources, these territorial residents also brought him corresponding gains.

    Although it is much slower than his mining speed, in general, these territorial residents can collect enough resources to a certain extent through mining.

    There are not many buildings and facilities in the early stage. At this time, I can still find some leisure time and personally join the team of collecting resources.

    But as the territory continues to develop, such time is destined to become less and less.

    When the time comes, these tools will have to be handed over to the people of the territory for use. Instead of doing this, it is better for them to try to get started now.

    What's more, in the early stage, development and growth are needed, and there will be a certain demand for these resources.

    After a simple inventory was completed, before Qin Tian could make any move, a prompt appeared in front of him.

    [The number of lords who have killed ferocious beasts has reached 10, and the amount of ferocious beasts will be gradually increased to promote the upgrading of lords! 】

    [The refresh probability of fierce beasts increases by 10%]

    This prompt appeared, and the speed of the world channel became extremely fast again.

    【? ? ? ? ? ? 】

    【What's going on? ! With so many lords so quickly, have they successfully killed the beast? We just encountered it in the wild. It has very strong combat power. Only by forming a team can we successfully defeat it. It is very difficult to kill! 】

    【May I ask? Is this reasonable? ! I have been growing up for a long time, and even food and clothing are a problem. How come there are so many people killing ferocious beasts in a short time? 】

    【What do you know? How can a real boss have time to watch the Water World Channel? 】

    【Hahaha! This is the truth. It feels like there are so many people crying miserably, but there are still big guys who can kill the ferocious beast! 】

    [I made a friend who is a big boss before, and he told me that he killed the ferocious beast, and the beast core can be sold for money and can be upgraded! 】

    【Is this killing me? The number of spawns of ferocious beasts has increased, how can I develop them? ! 】

    …

    Because of this reminder, many people in the World Channel began to complain crazily.

    However, most people complained in the same direction, expressing their shock at the fact that the ferocious beasts would increase the refresh rate. At the same time, many players were crying and wailing.

    For most players, what they can do now is to form a team, establish good relationships with other lords, and develop together.
